title: Build Agents with Cursor SDK
sourceSummary: Cursor launched an SDK that lets developers build production-ready coding agents using the same runtime and models that power Cursor. Run agents locally, on cloud VMs, or embed them in your products with just a few lines of TypeScript.

sections.title: The Agent Infrastructure Problem
sections.narration: Building reliable coding agents means solving sandboxing, state management, and context at scale.
sections.visualDescription: A whiteboard sketch showing tangled boxes labeled 'sandboxing', 'state', 'context', and 'models' connected by messy arrows, representing complexity.
sections.imagePrompt: Hand-drawn whiteboard illustration showing interconnected boxes and tangled arrows representing complex agent infrastructure components, black marker on white background, simple educational diagram style, clean lines with minimal gray shading, 16:9 aspect ratio

sections.title: Cursor SDK
sections.narration: Cursor SDK gives you production agents in a few lines of TypeScript.
sections.visualDescription: A whiteboard showing a simple code snippet with 'Agent.create()' transforming into a running agent icon with a checkmark.
sections.imagePrompt: Hand-drawn whiteboard illustration of a simple TypeScript code snippet on the left transforming via an arrow into a checkmark icon on the right, black marker on white background, minimal clean educational style, 16:9 aspect ratio

sections.title: Deploy Anywhere
sections.narration: Run agents on cloud VMs with dedicated environments, trigger them from CI/CD, or embed them directly in your product.
sections.visualDescription: A whiteboard diagram showing one 'Agent' box in the center with arrows pointing to three destinations: a cloud, a pipeline, and a product box.
sections.imagePrompt: Hand-drawn whiteboard diagram with a central circle labeled 'Agent' with three arrows pointing outward to simple icons representing cloud, CI/CD pipeline, and product interface, black marker on white background, clean educational style, 16:9 aspect ratio

sections.title: Start Building
sections.narration: Teams are already building on Composer 2 and frontier models. Vote for my project to see what's possible.
sections.visualDescription: A whiteboard showing 'Vote for My Project' with simple drawn checkmarks and upward trending arrows, conveying momentum and success.
